units.id: mission:Small Scale Delivery|dialog|260|0
units.english: You find a Korath who seems to have been waiting for you in the spaceport. They greet you by showing their palms, then outstretch their hands as if waiting to receive the package. You hand off the small delivery and they hand you a small payment of <payment>.
units.italian: Trovate un Korath che sembra avervi atteso nello spazioporto. Vi saluta mostrando i palmi, poi tende le mani come se aspettasse di ricevere il pacco. Consegnate la piccola spedizione e ricevete in cambio un piccolo pagamento di <payment>.

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 1|name|269|0
units.english: Distress call from the <EDC-ship>
units.italian: Chiamata di soccorso dalla <EDC-ship>

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 1|description|270|0
units.english: The Quarg have requested you respond to a distress call from the Efreti ship <EDC-ship>, which has crashed on <destination>. There are 40 survivors to rescue.
units.italian: I Quarg vi hanno chiesto di rispondere a una chiamata di soccorso della nave Efreti <EDC-ship>, precipitata su <destination>. Ci sono 40 superstiti da salvare.

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 1|The occasional blue flashes of Quarg ships are nothing new as you travel Efreti space. Usually that is all you see of the enigmatic aliens. Today, however, you receive an urgent hail from one of them as you land.|284|0
units.english: The occasional blue flashes of Quarg ships are nothing new as you travel Efreti space. Usually that is all you see of the enigmatic aliens. Today, however, you receive an urgent hail from one of them as you land.
units.italian: I lampi azzurri occasionali delle navi Quarg non sono una novità mentre attraversate lo spazio Efreti. Di solito è tutto ciò che vedete di questi alieni enigmatici. Oggi però, mentre atterrate, ricevete una chiamata urgente da una di loro.

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 1|	"Salutations, Captain of the <ship>. Victims of uncertain fate need your most diligent efforts, lest many families mourn the dead. Mereti drones waylayed the Efreti ship <EDC-ship> near <planet> ere it could elude. Two score Korath still live, awaiting rescue."|285|0
units.english: "Salutations, Captain of the <ship>. Victims of uncertain fate need your most diligent efforts, lest many families mourn the dead. Mereti drones waylayed the Efreti ship <EDC-ship> near <planet> ere it could elude. Two score Korath still live, awaiting rescue."
units.italian: "Salute, Capitano della <ship>. Vittime di sorte incerta esigono il vostro zelo più diligente, perché molte famiglie non abbiano a piangere i morti. I droni Mereti hanno teso un agguato alla nave Efreti <EDC-ship> presso <planet> prima che potesse sottrarsi. Quaranta Korath vivono ancora, in attesa di soccorso."

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 1|	"I'll go there immediately."|287|0
units.english: "I'll go there immediately."
units.italian: "Vado subito lì."

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 1|	"Can't the Quarg respond?"|289|0
units.english: "Can't the Quarg respond?"
units.italian: "Non possono intervenire i Quarg?"

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 1|	"I don't care about the Korath."|291|0
units.english: "I don't care about the Korath."
units.italian: "I Korath non mi interessano."

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 1|	"We vanquished the Mereti, but the <EDC-ship> fell beyond our reach at landfall. Without strong plate, we fare ill on a heavy world. A human can reach them days before an expedition from Kuwaru Efreti."|295|0
units.english: "We vanquished the Mereti, but the <EDC-ship> fell beyond our reach at landfall. Without strong plate, we fare ill on a heavy world. A human can reach them days before an expedition from Kuwaru Efreti."
units.italian: "Abbiamo vinto i Mereti, ma al suo atterraggio la <EDC-ship> è caduta oltre la nostra portata. Senza una corazza robusta, su un mondo pesante si patisce assai. Un umano può raggiungerli giorni prima di una spedizione da Kuwaru Efreti."

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 1|	"I'll go help, then."|297|0
units.english: "I'll go help, then."
units.italian: "Allora vado ad aiutarli."

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 1|	"I won't risk my ship for the Korath."|299|0
units.english: "I won't risk my ship for the Korath."
units.italian: "Non rischio la mia nave per i Korath."

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 1|	The Quarg is silent for some time. Eventually it responds, "Life is rare and precious across the vastness of space. Look about the Korath worlds and see what remains when one cares not what others suffer."|303|0
units.english: The Quarg is silent for some time. Eventually it responds, "Life is rare and precious across the vastness of space. Look about the Korath worlds and see what remains when one cares not what others suffer."
units.italian: Il Quarg tace per un po'. Alla fine risponde: "La vita è rara e preziosa nella vastità dello spazio. Guarda i mondi Korath e vedi ciò che resta quando non ci si cura di ciò che gli altri soffrono."

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 2|name|309|0
units.english: Return the <EDC-ship> survivors
units.italian: Riporta i superstiti della <EDC-ship>

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 2|description|310|0
units.english: Transport the <bunks> survivors of the <EDC-ship> to <planet>.
units.italian: Trasporta i <bunks> superstiti della <EDC-ship> su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 2|blocked|314|0
units.english: Looking towards the downed <EDC-ship>, you suddenly realize you forgot the <bunks> bunks you need for the evacuees.
units.italian: Guardando la <EDC-ship> abbattuta, vi rendete conto all'improvviso di aver dimenticato le <bunks> cuccette che vi servono per gli evacuati.

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 2|It takes you some time to find the <EDC-ship>. You had expected a beacon of some sort, but either they are keeping radio silence to avoid drawing the Mereti, or there were no survivors. When you manage to open the hatch, you find yourself staring down a thermal rifle.|319|0
units.english: It takes you some time to find the <EDC-ship>. You had expected a beacon of some sort, but either they are keeping radio silence to avoid drawing the Mereti, or there were no survivors. When you manage to open the hatch, you find yourself staring down a thermal rifle.
units.italian: Vi serve un po' di tempo per trovare la <EDC-ship>. Vi aspettavate un qualche faro di segnalazione, ma o tacciono per non attirare i Mereti, oppure non ci sono superstiti. Quando riuscite ad aprire il portello, vi trovate di fronte un fucile termico puntato.

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 2|	The Korath shouts something at you, and you hold your hands out with your palms forward. He limps back a few steps, but keeps the weapon trained on you. Slowly pulling a communicator out, you play a recording of the Quarg transmission you received earlier. Once the Korath hears the Quarg's voice, he becomes excited and lowers his rifle. "<planet>?" he asks repeatedly. You nod your head and show your palms again.|320|0
units.english: The Korath shouts something at you, and you hold your hands out with your palms forward. He limps back a few steps, but keeps the weapon trained on you. Slowly pulling a communicator out, you play a recording of the Quarg transmission you received earlier. Once the Korath hears the Quarg's voice, he becomes excited and lowers his rifle. "<planet>?" he asks repeatedly. You nod your head and show your palms again.
units.italian: Il Korath vi urla qualcosa addosso, e voi allungate le mani con i palmi in avanti. Zoppicando indietreggia di qualche passo, ma tiene l'arma puntata su di voi. Tirando fuori lentamente un comunicatore, riproducete una registrazione della trasmissione Quarg ricevuta prima. Appena il Korath sente la voce del Quarg, si entusiasma e abbassa il fucile. "<planet>?" chiede più volte. Fate un cenno col capo e mostrate di nuovo i palmi.

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 2|	He leads you into the ship, shouting into a communication device that is then broadcasted on speakers throughout the vessel. You can only glance around as you move through the engineering section, but it's clear they are running on emergency power, and several important-looking systems are destroyed. The living area is a makeshift hospital. You don't see any bodies, but there are far fewer Korath here than you would expect to crew a ship of this size. It's clear that all the surviving crew are injured to some degree, while more than half are incapacitated or unconscious. Even if the ship is spaceworthy, there aren't enough crew to fly it.|321|0
units.english: He leads you into the ship, shouting into a communication device that is then broadcasted on speakers throughout the vessel. You can only glance around as you move through the engineering section, but it's clear they are running on emergency power, and several important-looking systems are destroyed. The living area is a makeshift hospital. You don't see any bodies, but there are far fewer Korath here than you would expect to crew a ship of this size. It's clear that all the surviving crew are injured to some degree, while more than half are incapacitated or unconscious. Even if the ship is spaceworthy, there aren't enough crew to fly it.
units.italian: Vi conduce dentro la nave, urlando in un comunicatore il cui messaggio viene poi diffuso dagli altoparlanti in tutta la nave. Mentre attraversate la sezione di ingegneria riuscite solo a dare un'occhiata intorno, ma è chiaro che vanno con l'energia di emergenza, e diversi sistemi dall'aria importante sono distrutti. La zona abitativa è un ospedale di fortuna. Non vedete corpi, ma qui ci sono molti meno Korath di quanti ne servirebbero per equipaggiare una nave di questa dimensione. È evidente che tutto l'equipaggio superstite è ferito in qualche misura, e più della metà è inabile o incosciente. Anche se la nave è in grado di volare nello spazio, non c'è equipaggio abbastanza per pilotarla.

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 2|	You quickly count the number of survivors and communicate to your guide that you can take them all. He mimics your nodding head gesture, shows you his palms, and makes quick circles. You think he is agreeing and wants to hurry. Calling your crew over to help, the survivors are moved onboard the <ship>. Within a couple of hours you are ready to go.|322|0
units.english: You quickly count the number of survivors and communicate to your guide that you can take them all. He mimics your nodding head gesture, shows you his palms, and makes quick circles. You think he is agreeing and wants to hurry. Calling your crew over to help, the survivors are moved onboard the <ship>. Within a couple of hours you are ready to go.
units.italian: Contate in fretta i superstiti e comunicate alla vostra guida che potete portarli tutti. Lui imita il vostro cenno del capo, vi mostra i palmi e traccia cerchi rapidi. Pensate che sia d'accordo e che voglia fare in fretta. Chiamate il vostro equipaggio ad aiutare, e i superstiti vengono trasferiti a bordo della <ship>. Nel giro di un paio d'ore siete pronti a partire.

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 2|	You quickly count the number of survivors and communicate to your guide that you can take them all. He mimics your nodding head gesture, shows you his palms, and makes quick circles. You think he is agreeing and wants to hurry. With no crew helping you, it takes several hours to transfer the survivors to the <ship>.|326|0
units.english: You quickly count the number of survivors and communicate to your guide that you can take them all. He mimics your nodding head gesture, shows you his palms, and makes quick circles. You think he is agreeing and wants to hurry. With no crew helping you, it takes several hours to transfer the survivors to the <ship>.
units.italian: Contate in fretta i superstiti e comunicate alla vostra guida che potete portarli tutti. Lui imita il vostro cenno del capo, vi mostra i palmi e traccia cerchi rapidi. Pensate che sia d'accordo e che voglia fare in fretta. Senza nessuno del vostro equipaggio ad aiutarvi, ci vogliono diverse ore per trasferire i superstiti sulla <ship>.
